invariants.text: Customer.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Each customer must have a unique email address.
A customer's email address must be provided when creating a new customer.
A customer's name must be provided when creating a new customer.
A customer's phone number must be provided when creating a new customer.
Searching for customers by name returns only those customers whose name matches the search term exactly or contains it as a substring.
Filtering customers by email domain returns only those customers whose email address ends with the specified domain.
When a customer is deleted, their name, email, and phone number are removed from the database.
Updating a customer's email address must ensure that the new email is unique across all customers.
The application must persist customer data using SQLite.
The application must support creating, reading, updating, and deleting customer records.
